{{Short description|Italian mathematician (born 1967)}}
'''Elena Celledoni''' (born 1967){{r|born}} is an Italian mathematician who works in Norway as a professor of mathematical sciences at the [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]] (NTNU). Her research involves the [[numerical analysis]] of [[numerical algorithm]]s for [[partial differential equation]]s and for [[Lie group]] computations, including the study of structure preserving algorithms.

==Education and career==
Celledoni earned a master's degree at the [[University of Trieste]] in 1993. She completed a Ph.D. at the [[University of Padua]] in 1997.{{r|ntnu}} Her dissertation, ''Krylov Subspace Methods For Linear Systems Of ODEs'', was jointly supervised by Igor Moret and Alfredo Bellen.{{r|mg}}

Before becoming a faculty member at NTNU in 2004, she was a postdoctoral researcher at the [[University of Cambridge]], at the [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute]], and at NTNU.{{r|ntnu}}

==Recognition==
Celledoni is a member of the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]].{{r|dknvs}}
